But the worker who picked him up couldn’t let him leave empty handed. He then had no trouble finding a forever family. Thanks for showing Samantha so much love in the last video 🥺 Samantha was rescued by @foreverlandfarm #animalsanctuary, where she is now a permanent resident in their pack of great pyrs! Samantha lived with her owner, an older man, for 6 years of her life. She kept escaping, and was at risk of being harmed, so he took her to the vet's for euthanasia. Thankfully the vets reached out to FLF instead of putting this gorgeous girl down. She hasn't known love in her life till now, she is still learning touch is good and that people can be trusted.
